open_points.subject: M26 EffectAttempt.authority vs A10 draft-write sends
open_points.text: M26: "authority: the approval or the grant it used"; A10 rule 6: "A `draft-write` send records as its authority the FlowActivation M18 of the run's version."
open_points.question: What values are valid for `EffectAttempt.authority`, and where must draft-write authority be stored?
options: `authority` is a union of EffectApproval | StandingGrant | FlowActivation
`authority` stays approval/grant only, and draft-write uses null/implicit authority
store draft-write authority in another field, not `authority`

open_points.subject: Mapped node trace when node is skipped/upstream_failed
open_points.text: A13: "...makes its node `skipped_by_guard` without executing" and "...concludes `upstream_failed` without executing"; A15 rule 1: "every skipped node and every `upstream_failed` node writes exactly one NodeExecution" and also "A mapped node's trace is its elements' records; it has no record of its own, except ... empty list."
open_points.question: If a mapped node is skipped or upstream-failed before element execution, is there a node-level NodeExecution, per-element records, or no record?
options: write one node-level NodeExecution with no `map_index`
write one NodeExecution per would-be element
write no NodeExecution for that mapped node

open_points.subject: Flow port disclosure-class validation at composition
open_points.text: M01: "on a flow input the exact class ..." and "A flow output port carries no class either"; A05 rule 7 only refuses repeated ids/names and file carriage on flow I/O.
open_points.question: When composing a flow, must flow inputs always declare a class, and must flow outputs be refused if a class is provided?
options: require class on every flow input and forbid class on every flow output
default missing flow-input class to `open` and ignore output class
allow both and rely on later proof/runtime behavior
open_points.default_guess: Refuse composition unless each flow input has a class and each flow output has none.

open_points.subject: OperationBinding port well-formedness checks
open_points.text: A08 rule 5 defines manifest mismatch checks and ends with "or the ports do not fit the request shape of A09 rules 2 and 3".
open_points.question: Beyond HTTP request/response shape, which M01 port constraints are mandatory for binding ports (name uniqueness, carriage/media-type consistency, disclosure_class presence, etc.)?
options: validate full M01 constraints during proposal
accept loosely and fail later during proof/invocation
open_points.default_guess: Validate full M01 port constraints at proposal time.

open_points.subject: Manifest effect_class validity
open_points.text: A08: "effect class ... copied from the manifest record, never supplied by the proposer"; mismatch checks in rule 5 do not explicitly include "effect_class must be one of `read`, `draft-write`, `state-transition`, `external-effect`, `destructive`."
open_points.question: If a manifest capability has an unknown or malformed effect class, is proposal/invocation refused as manifest mismatch?
options: coerce/map unknown class to a known class
accept as-is and let later checks fail
